# Locally served dependencies

The application now serves its existing PDF and Word libraries locally, without changing their versions:

- pdfmake 0.2.9 — MIT — https://github.com/bpampuch/pdfmake — source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdfmake/0.2.9/pdfmake.min.js
- Mammoth 1.4.16 — BSD-2-Clause — https://github.com/mwilliamson/mammoth.js — source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/mammoth/1.4.16/mammoth.browser.min.js

Retain upstream license notices bundled with these distributions. The existing PDF.js and font bundles remain unchanged.

## Icon artwork

`pdf-icon-font.js` (and its on-screen counterparts `../cv-icon-paths.js` and
`../assets/icons/*.svg`) are generated by `npm run build:icons` from two
redistributable icon sets:

- simple-icons 13.x — CC0-1.0 — https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons — the brand marks (LinkedIn, GitHub, Kaggle, Hugging Face, …)
- Bootstrap Icons 1.13.x — MIT — https://github.com/twbs/icons — the generic marks (envelope, telephone, map pin, globe, link)

Brand names and logos remain trademarks of their respective owners; they are
used here only to label a link to that platform, which is what simple-icons
itself describes as acceptable use. Both packages are devDependencies — they
are needed to regenerate the assets, never to run or deploy the app.
